scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @space-hideout/shared build && concurrently -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "pnpm --filter @space-hideout/server dev" "pnpm --filter @space-hideout/client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @space-hideout/shared build && pnpm --filter @space-hideout/server build && pnpm --filter @space-hideout/client build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @space-hideout/shared typecheck && pnpm --filter @space-hideout/shared build && pnpm --filter @space-hideout/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @space-hideout/client typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @space-hideout/shared test && pnpm --filter @space-hideout/server test && pnpm --filter @space-hideout/client test
